dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: My prince, my fate, my one and only — the always so serious, so dutiful man...

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: My mysterious lover who tests my sincerity by being too busy with work... the one I think of day and night, the one I cannot forget...

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: He always passes this bridge after work. If I just buy a ticket and stand here every day, someday... he'll come to me.

dialogues.speaker: Roshchina
dialogues.text: Just like the past seventeen times — he always walks right past me with his head down, pretending not to notice me... how adorable he is.
